source: Full live cbdstore.in catalog, flagged directly by the project owner (has personally used this product): "Cannazo Uplift Plus... since no carrier is there its vapable/smokable, its pure extract no" — every 'extract' bucket product in the live catalog was defaulting to route=oral, including ones sold as a vape-pen/dab-syringe applicator.

raw.title: Cannazo- De-Waxed OG Kush Uplift+ Pen (Full Spectrum THC Extract Syringe) Golden Extract - 1G
raw.description: An extra-strong, THC-dominant Vijaya leaf extract formulated for experienced users. Concentrated full-spectrum formulation.

regression_note: Neither concentrate_markers ('no carrier oil' wording) nor concentrateSubWords ('dab'/'shatter'/'distillate') appear anywhere in this real listing's actual text — the ONLY signal that it's a dab/vape-pen product, not something swallowed, is 'Pen' and 'Syringe' in the name itself. The 'extract' legacy bucket's word list (categories.json) groups RSO/FECO (genuinely oral) and pure dab concentrates (genuinely inhaled) together with no route distinction; dabApplicatorWords (facets.go) is the narrow fix. Contrast with rso-feco-stays-oral.json — the default for 'extract' with none of these signals present is unchanged.
